claim: Players place fake plaza build sites to get builders to carry materials to a spot, then recycle the sites before they are built, which brought ten Planks to where they were needed.

evidence.reference: Player posts on the Outlanders community Discord, early November 2026.

notes: Matches the code: RecyclableBehaviour.GetRecycleValue returns the build site's pile counts (everything delivered) for an unfinished site, rather than 60% of the cost. A finished Basic House playtest showed the same full return for a half-built site (observation basic-house-demolition-refund). Where the returned items land is placed at the site's position in RecycleSiteBehaviour.OnWorkspotComplete; not separately timed in play.
